verses.text: Righteous people die, and no one cares. Faithful people are taken away, and no one understands that the righteous are taken away to be spared from evil.
They enter into peace. Those who walk uprightly find rest as they lie in death.
"But you, come here, you children of a sorceress, you children of people who cheat on their marriage and sell themselves!
Who are you making fun of? Who are you sneering at and sticking your tongue out at? Are you not children of rebels, children of liars?
You burn with desire among the oak trees and under every green tree. You kill your children as sacrifices in the valleys and under the overhanging rocks.
Your gods are the smooth stones of the valley. They are what you have chosen. You have poured out drink offerings to them and brought them grain offerings. Should these things make me calm?
You have made your bed on a high and lofty hill. You went up there to offer sacrifices.

Behind your doors and doorposts you have put your pagan symbols. You left me and uncovered your bed. You climbed into it and opened it wide. You made a deal with those whose beds you love, and you looked at their nakedness.
You went to the god Molech with olive oil and plenty of perfumes. You sent your messengers far away. You even went down to the grave itself.
You wore yourself out with all your traveling, but you never said, 'It is hopeless.' You found new strength, so you did not give up.
Who were you so afraid of that you lied to me? You did not remember me or think about me. Is it because I have been silent for so long that you do not fear me?
I will expose your so called righteousness and your works, and they will not help you.

When you cry out for help, let your collection of idols save you! The wind will carry them all away. A single breath will blow them away. But whoever takes shelter in me will receive the land and own my holy mountain."
And it will be said: "Build up, build up the road! Prepare the way! Remove the obstacles from the road of my people."

For this is what the high and lifted up One says, who lives forever, whose name is Holy: "I live in a high and holy place, but also with those who are sorry for their sins and humble in spirit. I bring new life to the spirit of the humble and new life to the hearts of those who are sorry.
I will not keep accusing forever, and I will not always be angry. Otherwise the spirit of the people I have created would grow faint before me.
I was angry because of their sinful greed. I punished them and hid my face in anger. Yet they kept on going their own stubborn way.
I have seen their ways, but I will heal them. I will lead them and comfort them again, and comfort those who mourn among them.
I will put praise on their lips. Peace, peace, to those far away and to those near," says the LORD. "I will heal them."
But the wicked are like the tossing sea, which cannot rest. Its waves throw up mud and dirt.
"There is no peace for the wicked," says my God.
